facts.fact: On the morning after ch3, Devan says to the shutters, 'The third slat creaks. I've never fixed it.' Neela finds the bar seated in its brackets as she left it and cannot read whether he heard her.
At first light at the end of ch4, both leaves of the warden's shutters are swung wide open, though Neela had left one leaf ajar; no face or lamp shows.
